stem: Copper is a transition element with atomic number 29.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Complete the electronic configurations of a Cu atom and a $\text{Cu}^+$ ion.

$\text{Cu}^+ \text{ ion } 1\text{s}^22\text{s}^22\text{p}^6$

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
$\text{Cu}^+$ ions form a linear complex with $\text{Cl}^-$ ions, which are monodentate ligands.

Draw the structure of this complex and include its overall charge.

parts.label: (c)
(d)
parts.text:
When $\text{NH}_3\text{(aq)}$ is added to $\text{Cu}^{2+}\text{(aq)}$, dropwise at first and then in excess, two chemical reactions occur as shown.

$$[\text{Cu}(\text{H}_2\text{O})_6]^{2+} \xrightarrow[\text{reaction 1}]{\text{dropwise }\text{NH}_3\text{(aq)}} \mathbf{A} \xrightarrow[\text{reaction 2}]{\text{excess }\text{NH}_3\text{(aq)}} \mathbf{B}$$

For each reaction, describe what you would see and write an equation.

reaction 1

reaction 2

parts.label: (e)(i)
parts.stem: $\text{EDTA}^{4-}$ is a polydentate ligand. When a solution of $\text{EDTA}^{4-}$ is added to a solution containing $[\text{Cu}(\text{H}_2\text{O})_6]^{2+}$ a new complex is formed. The formula of this complex is $[\text{CuEDTA}]^{2-}$.
parts.text: Name the type of reaction occurring here.

parts.label: (e)(ii)
parts.text: Write an expression for the stability constant, $K_{\text{stab}}$, of $[\text{CuEDTA}]^{2-}$ in this reaction.

parts.label: (e)(iii)
parts.text:
The numerical value of the $K_{\text{stab}}$ of $[\text{CuEDTA}]^{2-}$ is $6.3 \times 10^{19}$ at $298\text{ K}$.

State what this tells us about the $[\text{CuEDTA}]^{2-}$ complex ion.

parts.label: (f)(i)
parts.stem: Ethanedioate ions, $\text{C}_2\text{O}_4^{2-}$, can act as a bidentate ligand.
parts.text: Explain what is meant by the term bidentate ligand.

parts.label: (f)(ii)
parts.text:
When ethanedioate ions are added to a solution of zirconium ions, $\text{Zr}^{4+}$, a complex ion containing four $\text{C}_2\text{O}_4^{2-}$ ions and one $\text{Zr}^{4+}$ ion is formed. All four ethanedioate ions act as bidentate ligands in this complex.

Give the formula of this complex ion and explain why this complex is not octahedral.
